label: ILLUSTRATIONS: simulated normal-model data, not empirical findings or literature replications
random_streams: random.Random with SHA256-derived integer seeds by scenario label; explicit normal draws

monte_carlo.mean_mcse: Sample SD of independent replication-level values divided by sqrt(n)
monte_carlo.rate_mcse: sqrt(p_hat*(1-p_hat)/n); Wilson 95% intervals also reported, including boundaries
monte_carlo.conditional_metrics: n is the selected count, not the total number simulated; no selected values means null, not zero
monte_carlo.paired_metrics: Subtract policies or discovery/holdout estimates within a replication before computing MCSE
monte_carlo.scope: These errors quantify simulation noise under the chosen DGP, not empirical, identification or model uncertainty

design.label: ILLUSTRATION: synthetic normal effect measurements; no empirical data
design.estimand: Fixed hypothetical mean one-year policy effect in an eligible target population
design.dgp: Yi iid N(theta, 1000^2); draw Xbar directly from N(theta, 1000^2/n)
design.estimator: Unbiased sample mean Xbar; no fitted nuisance parameters
design.uncertainty_model: Known-SE normal inference; report sigma/sqrt(n) except explicit ratio-0.5 stress case
design.identification: Effect measurements assumed unbiased for the target; confounding, spillovers and transport problems absent by design
design.margin_basis: Fixed teaching assumption before simulation, not an estimated welfare threshold
design.decision_criterion: No adoption decision or utility loss; compare zero-null, equivalence and positive-above-margin classifications
design.error_events: False zero rejection under theta=0; false equivalence under |theta|>=100; interval noncoverage
design.monte_carlo: Independent repeated studies within each scenario. Rates have binomial MCSE and Wilson intervals; mean has sample-SD/sqrt(R) MCSE. These are not the study's sampling SE or confidence interval.
design.limitations: No real policy calibration, estimated variances, clustering, serial dependence, selective reporting or causal identification test. SE stress changes only reported uncertainty; it does not generate dependent raw data.

design.label: ILLUSTRATION: synthetic normal estimates, not observed market returns
design.estimand: Population monthly gross factor-model alpha of a stipulated hypothetical candidate
design.population: Hypothetical repeated studies of fixed candidates in one unchanged trading regime
design.units: basis points per month; no annualisation or trading costs
design.dgp: Discovery X and independent holdout Y are N(theta, 10^2); fixed theta within each single-candidate scenario. Search has 20 independent theta=0 candidates per repetition.
design.estimator: Normal estimate of alpha with known standard error 10 bp
design.selection: Two-sided zero-null test at alpha=.05, retaining abs(X/10)>z_.975
design.error_criterion: Rejection, conditional sign error, conditional absolute exaggeration and estimation bias; no welfare loss or investment recommendation is specified
design.assumptions: Correct normal model; known SE; unchanged effect across discovery and holdout; independent studies and candidates; no factor misspecification, dependence, costs, market adaptation or optional stopping
design.monte_carlo: Rate MCSE=sqrt(p_hat*(1-p_hat)/denominator); mean MCSE=sample SD/sqrt(denominator); conditional denominators are selected-study counts. Wilson95 accompanies rates; not a confidence interval for an economic effect.
design.undefined: Type S and Type M are undefined at theta=0; every conditional metric is unavailable when no study is selected. JSON null is not zero. Small selected counts make asymptotic MCSE unreliable.
design.pairing: Discovery and holdout differences are summarised within study; their MCSE uses paired differences rather than adding independent group standard errors
design.source_limit: Conceptual motivation uses existing selected-section Gelman–Carlin notes. Finance notes have abstract/selected-section coverage. No new source reading or replication of their empirical findings is claimed.

parameters.search: Select maximum absolute discovery z; publish if unadjusted p < alpha

design.label: Illustration: synthetic policy evaluation, not evidence about a real programme
design.random_streams: Stable SHA-256 derivation from base seed and named scenario; each derived seed is reported
design.estimand: Unknown average gross benefit theta in one fixed eligible population over one year
design.units: pounds per eligible person over one year; adoption probabilities are unitless
design.dgp: Theta is normal with scenario mean/SD, or fixed when SD=0; estimate|theta ~ N(theta,500^2)
design.estimator: Unbiased normal estimate with known SE=500; identification is assumed valid
design.actions: Adopt once or choose status quo; all policies face identical simulated states and estimates
design.utility: adopt*(theta-cost), linear risk-neutral per-person payoff; status quo payoff zero
design.loss: Oracle regret=max(theta-cost,0)-utility; oracle knows theta but policies do not
design.priors: Baseline N(0,1000^2), skeptical N(0,100^2); both proper and fixed before outcomes
design.cost_confidence_rule: Adopt iff the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound exceeds known cost; false adoption probability <=.05 for theta<=cost under the model
design.evaluation: Matched prior predictive, mismatched prior predictive and fixed-state sampling performance are distinguished
design.paired_comparisons: Other policy minus baseline Bayes on each shared replication; report sample SD of differences / sqrt(R)
design.mc_error: Mean MCSE is sample SD/sqrt(R); rate MCSE is sqrt(p_hat*(1-p_hat)/R), with Wilson 95% interval
design.limitations: No individual outcome noise, welfare weights, risk aversion, uncertain costs, partial identification, delay, learning or realistic programme data
